content.short: FudBuddies is a premier Cardano NFT collection of 6,666 creatures with 3D avatar utility in the Future Fest metaverse.
content.description: FudBuddies is one of Cardano's most recognized NFT collections, featuring 6,666 unique digital creatures with a focus on community and cross-project utility. Through a strategic partnership with Future Fest, FudBuddies holders can use their NFTs as 3D playable avatars within virtual event worlds. The project emphasizes 'backwards utility,' providing holders with exclusive access to social gatherings, live concerts, and airdrops. With additional collections like FudPets and FudHeadz, the ecosystem expands across Cardano gaming and social metaverse spaces.
